scope: Portico Community 1 chat to 1 Linux Scoped; normal executable, no synthetic test tools
meaning: LAB_PASS = focused disposable evidence only. Does not mean universal MCP conformance. PARTIAL/NOT_PROVEN/REAL_ENV_PENDING/RAW_FAIL explicitly block blanket compliance.
freeze_rule: Release gate remains BLOCKED absent independent review, target HTTPS OAuth evidence, and normatively justified applicability acceptance; the 37-scenario raw upstream result must be retained as-is.

controls.rule: JSON-RPC 2026 envelope validation, request IDs, resultType and errors
controls.limitation: Actual Gateway POST rejects invalid JSON/version/method/params/IDs as structured -32700/-32600/-32602; SDK reports invalid tool arguments with isError=true; all cases assert no Executor invocation. Exhaustive response envelope and schema variants still unproven.

controls.rule: Per-request stateless _meta and client information
controls.limitation: Reject missing metadata; no conversation-based implicit authorization

controls.rule: Protocol version mismatch and historical unsupported versions
controls.limitation: Structured -32022 supported/requested and original JSON-RPC ID

controls.rule: Streamable HTTP POST, valid notification semantics, content-type
controls.limitation: Parser now rejects invalid notification-like messages with structured HTTP 400 instead of SDK 202. Valid extension notifications, Accept negotiation and every Content-Type variant not yet exhaustively proven.

controls.rule: Mcp-Method and Mcp-Name/body header matching
controls.limitation: Forged metadata does not reach executor

controls.rule: Mcp-Name Base64 encoding and invalid sentinel
controls.limitation: Encoded name matched against body on actual Handler

controls.rule: Duplicate scalar header ambiguity
controls.limitation: Conflicting or repeated MCP headers fail closed

controls.rule: Mcp-Param annotations and mirrors
controls.limitation: No product x-mcp-header parameter annotations claimed; verify complete schema inventory

controls.rule: Origin 403 on invalid browser origin
controls.limitation: Hostile, malformed, duplicated and host-rebinding Origin rejected

controls.rule: Implicit and explicit HTTP(S) default port in Origin
controls.limitation: Trusted resource origin scheme/host/effective-port; invalid port refused

controls.rule: Independent stateless HTTP POST requests
controls.limitation: No legacy MCP session token required

controls.rule: Cancellation propagation and no further SSE events
controls.limitation: Actual Streamable HTTP Handler passes client request-context cancellation to in-flight Executor, with no privileged Broker effects. SSE-stream close not applicable to JSONResponse profile; cancellation of a remote Broker side effect under timeout requires separate proof.

controls.rule: Optional SSE per-request response vs JSON profile
controls.limitation: 2026 Streamable HTTP accepts either JSON or request-scoped SSE; Community sets JSONResponse=true. SSE streaming is not claimed. Cancellation under load remains C12.

controls.rule: Subscriptions/listen stream behavior
controls.limitation: Do not claim dynamic list notifications without demonstrated subscription semantics

controls.rule: OAuth protected resource metadata
controls.limitation: TLS endpoint returns resource and issuer; synthetic provider

controls.rule: 401 bearer challenge with resource_metadata
controls.limitation: Missing bearer cannot reach Broker; client discovery verified in fixture

controls.rule: Verified TLS for OAuth introspection
controls.limitation: Child process certificate trust; real Docker/VPS introspection remains UNVALIDATED

controls.rule: No introspection 302/307 redirects or environment proxy
controls.limitation: Verified credentials never redirected to another server

controls.rule: Invalid certificate and HTTP Docker hostname fail closed
controls.limitation: Only numeric loopback fixtures can use plaintext HTTP

controls.rule: Token issuer/audience/expiration and exact scopes
controls.limitation: Negative and positive OAuth→Broker fixture, not production ZITADEL

controls.rule: OAuth subject isolation through IPC/Broker
controls.limitation: Subject propagation and pending grants isolate principals in fixture

controls.rule: tools/list complete, no test-only diagnostics in product
controls.limitation: Real Gateway tools/list catalog checked twice for stable order, unique names and descriptor schemas; synthetic conformance names excluded in production profile probe.

controls.rule: tool input schema validation and bounded responses
controls.limitation: Actual tools/list all descriptors resolved against local JSON Schema 2020-12; outputSchema tested with system.info structured result. Runtime rejection and other structured outputs remain PARTIAL.

controls.rule: rate limit invocations per subject and global
controls.limitation: Temporal bucket and HTTP 429 with Retry-After

controls.rule: Broker Scoped policy is authoritative
controls.limitation: TLS bearer cannot read outside permitted root, even when authenticated

controls.rule: Operator grant requires independent authenticated decision
controls.limitation: Pending never grants; fixture approve/deny/revoke; real human/browser pending

controls.rule: Optional adaptive MRTR navigation state integrity and client capability checks
controls.limitation: Signed invalid/expired/cross-subject/cross-target MRTR states reject before Broker; valid client accept reads approval_status only and cannot grant access. Live client MRTR compatibility, true retry interoperability and operator-authenticated decision need separate evidence.

controls.rule: resources/list and resource-not-found responses
controls.limitation: No real production synthetic resource tools

controls.rule: prompts/list and advertised static prompt capability
controls.limitation: Empty catalog permitted; no promises of listChanged

controls.rule: completion/complete
controls.limitation: Frozen official runner calls optional method even though not advertised; preserve FAIL

controls.rule: Deprecated optional MCP logging capability not advertised
controls.limitation: 2026-07-28 logging is deprecated; request-scoped notifications/message not emitted. No obsolete logging/setLevel obligation. Broker audit and runtime observability are separate.

controls.rule: JSON Schema 2020-12 and output-schema dialect
controls.limitation: All current input/output catalog schemas resolved offline with local refs as JSON Schema 2020-12. Runtime validation of arbitrary composition and conditionals, and structuredContent for every tool, not exhaustively proven.

controls.rule: Real ChatGPT OAuth and operator HTTPS browser grant
controls.limitation: Owner/real client approval is separate Gate E

controls.rule: Real target Docker/Traefik HTTPS backchannel + rollback
controls.limitation: Disposable TLS tests do not assert real CA, hostname, deployment or rollback

controls.rule: Independent normative reviewer signoff on exact release SHA
controls.limitation: Implementer cannot sign own review; issue #130 remains open

controls.rule: Raw 37 scenario frozen upstream score, no waivers
controls.limitation: Normal 8/2/3/24; synthetic lab 35/1/1/0 at last evidenced SHA; both release_gate_passed=false
